an8.55:1.1: Atha kho Ujjayo brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
an8.55:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Ujjayo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.55:1.4: tesan no bhavaṃ Gotamo amhākaṃ tathā dhammaṃ desetu, ye amhākaṃ assu dhammā diṭṭhadhammahitāya diṭṭhadhammasukhāya samparāyahitāya samparāyasukhāyā' ti. 2.
an8.55:2.1: Cattāro 'me brāhmaṇa dhammā kulaputtassa diṭṭhadhammahitāya saṃvattanti diṭṭhadhammasukhāya.
an8.55:3.2: Idha brāhmaṇa kulaputto yena kammaṭṭhānena jīvikaṃ kappeti
an8.55:3.3: yadi kasiyā yadi vaṇijjāya yadi gorakkhena yadi issatthena yadi rājaporisena yadi sippaññatarena,
an8.55:3.4: tattha dakkho hoti analaso tatrupāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ.
an8.55:4.2: Idha brāhmaṇa kulaputtassa bhogā honti uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sedāvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā,
an8.55:4.4: ‘kinti me ime bhoge neva rājāno hareyyuṃ, na corā hareyyuṃ, na aggi ḍaheyya, na udakaṃ vaheyya, na appiyā dāyādā hareyyun' ti.
an8.55:5.2: Idha brāhmaṇa kulaputto yasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā paṭivasati, tattha ye te honti gahapati vā gahapatiputtā vā daharā vā vuddhasīlino vuddhā vā vuddhasīlino saddhāsampannā sīlasampannā cāgasampannā paññāsampannā, tehi saddhiṃ santiṭṭhati sallapati sākacchaṃ samāpajjati; yathārūpānaṃ saddhāsampannānaṃ saddhāsampadaṃ anusikkhati, yathārūpānaṃ sīlasampannānaṃ sīlasampadaṃ anusikkhati, yathārūpānaṃ cāgasampannānaṃ cāgasampadaṃ anusikkhati, yathārūpānaṃ paññāsampannānaṃ paññāsampadaṃ anusikkhati.
an8.55:6.2: Idha brāhmaṇa kulaputto āyañ ca bhogānaṃ viditvā vayañ ca bhogānaṃ viditvā samaṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti na accogāḷhaṃ na atihīnaṃ ‘evaṃ me āyo vayaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, na ca me vayo āyaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatī' ti.
an8.55:6.3: Seyyathā pi brāhmaṇa tulādhāro vā tulādhārantevāsī vā tulaṃ paggahetvā jānāti ‘ettakena vā onataṃ ettakena vā unnatan' ti, evam
an8.55:6.4: eva kho brāhmaṇa kulaputto āyañ ca bhogānaṃ viditvā vayañ ca bhogānaṃ viditvā samaṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti na accogāḷhaṃ na atihīnaṃ ‘evaṃ me āyo vayaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, na ca me vayo āyaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatī' ti.
an8.55:6.5: Sacāyaṃ brāhmaṇa kulaputto appāyo samāno uḷāraṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti, tassa bhavanti vattāro ‘udumbarakhādikaṃ 'vāyaṃ kulaputto bhoge khādatī' ti.
an8.55:6.6: Sace panāyaṃ brāhmaṇa kulaputto mahāyo samāno kasiraṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti, tassa bhavanti vattāro ‘ajaddhumārikaṃ 'vāyaṃ kulaputto marissatī' to.
an8.55:6.7: Yato ca khvāyaṃ brāhmaṇa kulaputto āyañ ca bhogānaṃ viditvā vayañ ca bhogānaṃ viditvā samaṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti na accogāḷhaṃ na atihīnaṃ ‘evaṃ me āyo vayaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, na ca me vayo āyaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatī' ti.
an8.55:7.1: Evaṃ samuppannānaṃ brāhmaṇa bhogānaṃ cattāri apāyamukhāni honti:
an8.55:7.2: itthidhutto hoti, surādhutto, akkhadhutto, pāpamitto pāpasahāyo pāpasampavaṅko.
an8.55:7.3: Seyyathā pi brāhmaṇa mahato taḷākassa cattāri c' eva āyamukhāni cattāri ca apāyamukhāni, tassa puriso yāni c' eva āyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya, yāni ca apāyamukhāni tāni vivareyya, devo ca na sammā dhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya; evaṃ hi tassa brāhmaṇa mahato taḷākassa parihāni yeva pāṭikaṅkhā no vuddhi:
an8.55:7.4: evam eva kho brāhmaṇa evaṃ samuppannānaṃ bhogānaṃ cattāri apāyamukhāni honti:
an8.55:7.5: itthidhutto hoti, surādhutto, akkhadhutto, pāpamitto pāpasahāyo pāpasampavaṅko. 9.
an8.55:8.1: Evaṃ samuppannānaṃ brāhmaṇa bhogānaṃ cattāri āyamukhāni honti:
an8.55:8.2: na-itthidhutto hoti, na-surādhutto, naakkhadhutto, kalyāṇamitto kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko.
an8.55:8.3: Seyyathā pi brāhmaṇa mahato taḷākassa cattāri c' eva āyamukhāni cattāri ca apāyamukhāni, tassa puriso yāni c' eva āyamukhāni tāni vivareyya, yāni ca apāyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya, devo ca sammā dhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya; evaṃ hi tassa brāhmaṇa mahato taḷākassa vuddhi yeva pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni:
an8.55:8.4: evam eva kho brāhmaṇa evaṃ samuppannānaṃ bhogānaṃ cattāri āyamukhāni honti:
an8.55:9.1: Ime kho brāhmaṇa cattāro dhammā kulaputtassa diṭṭhadhammahitāya saṃvattanti diṭṭhadhammasukhāya. 10.
an8.55:10.1: Cattāro 'me brāhmaṇa dhammā kulaputtassa samparāyahitāya saṃvattanti samparāyasukhāya.
an8.55:10.5: Idha brāhmaṇa kulaputto saddho hoti, saddahati Tathāgatassa bodhiṃ
an8.55:10.6: ‘iti pi so Bhagavā . . . pe . . . Satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho Bhagavā' ti.
an8.55:11.2: Idha brāhmaṇa kulaputto pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti . . . pe . . . surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti.
an8.55:12.2: Idha brāhmaṇa kulaputto vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati . . . pe . . . yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato.
an8.55:13.2: Idha brāhmaṇa kulaputto paññavā hoti . . . pe . . . sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
an8.55:14.1: Ime kho brāhmaṇa cattāro dhammā kulaputtassa samparāyahitāya saṃvattanti samparāyasukhāyā ti.
